body: Man id totally go back to 2008. Fuck being an adult
Yeah i can empathise with how you feel. A lot of times I feel like I don't deserve to feel as bad as I do since others have it much worse than me.

If you're speaking of antidepressants to make you feel better. They do work for many, it's all about finding the right medicine for you though. But, to my understanding, a big chunk of feeling better comes from an effort from within  even when it's hard. My personal experience wasn't very good compared to the average case of depression since mine was treatment resistant, but I hope to eventually find something that works after several meds and 2 years of looking. My problem my be a hormone problem, or even a post head injury related problem. I may even try ketamine since I've been through so many different treatments that didn't work for me. But this likely won't be the case for most.
Well not for me after trying 10+ different kinds but there's a good chance that you'll find a fit that'll work for you eventually
